svg.aria-label: Glance, for macOS. Your Mac and every agent on it. At a glance. A native Mac app that shows, in plain words, what each coding agent is doing and how your Mac is holding up. Runs entirely on your Mac. No account, no cloud. Below, Glance's Agents window: four coding agents, one of them asking permission to run a command.
